summary: Ilex was a Nomai child who grew up on both Ember Twin and Brittle Hollow. Ilex played the Anglerfish game with Solanum and other children, wrote a school essay arguing the Nomai should build a new Vessel instead of pouring resources into the Ash Twin Project, and left a cautionary poem about Brittle Hollow's black hole.

behavior: Ilex was the tallest child among their Anglerfish-game friends.
Ilex pushed for older children to wear blindfolds in the Anglerfish game for scientific accuracy.
location: Ilex grew up on Ember Twin in the Sunless City.
Ilex later attended school in the Hanging City on Brittle Hollow.
Ilex visited the Old Settlement on Brittle Hollow.
lore: Ilex played the Anglerfish game in the Sunless City with Laevi, Lami, Taget, and Solanum.
Ilex's Anglerfish-game rule was that anyone old enough should wear a blindfold since real Anglerfish are blind.
Ilex wrote a school essay 'Why We Should Build A New Vessel.'
Ilex's essay argued the Nomai should build a smaller Vessel first and grow it later by reaching planets with more resources.
Coleus told Ilex that the Nomai used to meet other clans and learn from them.
Poke told Ilex of her plans to make a very advanced warp core for a different project.
Yarrow told Ilex that the Nomai use a lot of resources on the Ash Twin Project.
Ilex concluded the Nomai should stop building things to search for the Eye and instead build a new Vessel.
Ilex left a cautionary five-line poem at the Old Settlement warning visitors to look out for Brittle Hollow's central black hole.
Ilex died when Ghost Matter from the Interloper spread throughout the solar system.
Ilex's remains' location is not specified.
